rules.description: OmniWM modifier + D: open applications palette
OmniWM modifier + Control + Shift + Q: force quit focused app

to.shell_command: /usr/bin/swift -e 'import AppKit; if let app = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication { app.forceTerminate() }'

rules.description: OmniWM modifier + Shift + Q: quit focused app normally
DZ60: map OmniWM modifier to Right Command
Built-in keyboard: map OmniWM modifier to Right Command
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+X => Cmd+C (Copy), Cmd+V (Paste), Cmd+X (Cut)
Ctrl+(Shift)+Right/left arrow => Alt+(Shift)+Right/left arrow (Move cursor one word with selection and without selection)
